newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Vanik Inc shares rise on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Vanik Inc shares rise on bargain hunting.

text.p: Shares of investment bank Vanik Inc Ltd rose 3.9 percent, or 50 cents, to 13.25 rupees on bargain hunting by retail investors on Tuesday, brokers said.
"Vanik is the type of cheap, liquid stock which small investors always buy when the market shows signs of firming," said a local broker.
Vanik shares rose to 13.50 rupees on volume of 18,000 shares but fell back to 13.25 on some profit-taking, brokers said.
"Small investors can book quick short-term profits with shares like Vanik," another broker said.
The all share index, which closed at 580.70 on Monday, has risen by more than three percent in the past two weeks.
